introducing.name: Colonel George Butterworth
introducing.description: A British-accented colonel in the [[organization:united-states-of-eurasia|United States of Eurasia]] Army Corps. Wary at first that [[character:riker]] and [[character:homer]] are FAITH loyalists, he briefs them on the [[event:solar-system-war]] and judges that [[location:earth]] will not recover in time for humanity.
introducing.current_state: Leading a surviving [[organization:united-states-of-eurasia]] group from an underground military installation while coordinating with [[character:riker]] and [[character:homer]].

introducing.name: USE colony ship
introducing.description: A planned [[organization:united-states-of-eurasia]] colony ship designed by refugee scientists as an off-world refuge. Its plans require a space-based construction yard and a viable destination.
introducing.current_state: The first construction effort was a casualty of the war; a new effort to build two colony ships is beginning and is expected to take most of a decade.

introducing.name: Solar-system war
introducing.description: A system-wide war that grew from strategic conflict in space into nuclear attacks and attacks on civilian targets. The attempted destruction of [[vessel:heaven-1]] became its tipping point. Retaliation led to abandoned stations and colonies, recalled personnel, destroyed transports, and a Brazilian campaign against civilians that killed billions.

updates.current_state: At [[location:sol]] with [[character:homer]], coordinating with a surviving [[organization:united-states-of-eurasia]] group and beginning plans to use their manufacturing capacity to build two colony ships.

At [[location:sol]] with [[character:riker]], coordinating with a surviving [[organization:united-states-of-eurasia]] group and beginning plans to use their manufacturing capacity to build two colony ships.
At [[location:sol]], carrying [[character:riker]] and using its transmitter to contact a surviving [[organization:united-states-of-eurasia]] group.

updates.description: The United States of Eurasia controls Europe and most of western Russia. It began an interstellar probe project two years earlier, and [[character:dr-landers]] considers it the strongest long-term competitor, with a substantial lead in colonization readiness. It operates a space station on [[location:titan]] to study primitive life found there. Its probe launched shortly after [[character:bob-replicant|Bob-1]] has not been heard from again.
updates.current_state: A surviving Army Corps and civilian group is maintaining an underground refuge and seeking colony ships to preserve [[species:human|humanity]].

updates.description: A belligerent power believed by [[character:dr-landers]]'s organization to be potentially arming its probes and to be the most likely sabotage threat. His organization expects it to launch multiple probes and, if it finds a suitable system, establish a military presence and reproduce there. Its remaining ships have pursued a scorched-earth campaign against civilians.

A major power whose probe project is sacrificing other concerns for speed and is expected to use an [[technology:ami]]. [[character:dr-landers]]'s organization considers its project the most likely to fail outright. Its probe launched shortly after [[character:bob-replicant|Bob-1]].

An automated factory used to gather and refine resources and to produce drones. It accepts designs made in virtual space and builds them with [[technology:3d-printers]], [[technology:roamers]], and [[technology:nanites]].

A virtual-reality interface [[character:bob-replicant]] builds aboard [[vessel:heaven-1]] to give a bodiless mind sensory input and an embodied experience. Still an ongoing software project, it produces physical sensations that feel real and a full humanlike avatar, and planned improvements aim at more direct interaction between users.

updates.state: Cloud and dust hide a surface scarred by dozens of asteroid and nuclear impacts that have disrupted the weather. A survivor group estimates the population at under twenty million, with recovery taking five to ten thousand years.
updates.description: Mostly harmless. The homeworld of [[species:human|humanity]]. Its places include [[location:las-vegas]], where [[character:robert-johansson|Bob]] dies in the [[event:bob-road-incident|road incident]] of 2016; [[location:new-handeltown]], formerly Portland, where he is revived as a replicant in 2133; and [[location:old-handeltown]], formerly Salem, Oregon, whose memorial to Handel was destroyed by a nuclear weapon. [[event:four-asteroid-diversion|Four asteroids]] aimed at it are diverted, but the [[event:solar-system-war|solar-system war]] scars its surface with asteroid and nuclear impacts and disrupts its weather.

A stellar system estimated to be about one billion years old and selected as [[vessel:heaven-1]]'s destination. It is not suitable for an unprotected human settlement, though people could live there under a dome. Its planets are the hot, airless [[location:ee-1|EE-1]], the marginally livable [[location:ee-2]], the moon-rich giant [[location:ee-3]] and [[location:ee-4]]. It hosts [[character:bill]]'s [[location:bill-skunkworks|skunkworks]], the workshop for the system's manufacturing and research.

The planetary system of Sol is home to [[species:human|humanity]] on [[location:earth]]. Its other planets are [[location:mercury]], [[location:venus]], [[location:mars]], [[location:jupiter]], [[location:saturn]], [[location:uranus]] and [[location:neptune]], and it includes the [[location:asteroid-belt|asteroid belt]], [[location:kuiper-belt|Kuiper belt]] and [[location:oort-cloud|Oort cloud]]. The [[organization:united-states-of-eurasia|USE]] built a station on [[location:titan]] to study the primitive life found there. It is the site of the [[event:four-asteroid-diversion|diversion of four asteroids]] aimed at Earth and of the [[event:solar-system-war|solar-system war]], which devastated Earth.

summary: [[character:riker]] and [[character:homer]] establish contact with [[character:george-butterworth|Colonel Butterworth]]'s surviving [[organization:united-states-of-eurasia]] force after stopping the last Brazilian ships. Butterworth describes a devastated [[location:earth]] and proposes using the Heaven vessels' manufacturing capacity to build two colony ships. Riker and Homer agree to begin while Riker searches for a viable destination among nearby stars.
